description: Searches authorized invoices using bounded customer, job, status, payment, due-date, and total fields; payment links and addresses are excluded. Use to search invoices in the connected business. Returns query, count, total, invoices, resolution, scope.

customer_id.description: Restrict results to one customer ID.

job_id.description: Restrict results to one job ID.

limit.description: Maximum number of invoices to return.

payment_status.description: Authoritative payment state, such as unpaid, pending, paid, or refunded.

query.description: Invoice number, customer name, email, phone, job title, or description.

name: search-invoices

invoices.description: Bounded invoices records returned by this tool.

query.description: Query used or returned by this tool.

resolution.description: Resolution metadata; empty collections retain their existing JSON array representation.

scope.description: Authorization scope of this result; data remains restricted to the connected business.

title: Search Invoices Tool
